rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for an aircraft descending onto a surface, rather than causing it to land.

example.english: The plane is about to land.
example.jyutping: gaa3 fei1 gei1 zau6 faai3 zoek3 luk6 laa3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for dry ground rather than water.

example.english: We are still far from land.
example.traditional: 我哋而家離陸地仲好遠。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 lei4 luk6 dei6 zung6 hou2 jyun5

rows.note: Use this for land owned or used as property, especially for building.

example.english: This plot of land cannot be used to build high-rises.
example.traditional: 呢幅土地唔可以起高樓。
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 tou2 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 hei2 gou1 lau4

rows.note: Use this everyday verb when someone successfully gets or secures something such as a job.

example.english: I finally managed to land a job.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 wan2 dou2 fan6 gung1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when “land” means a country or nation, not merely an area.

example.english: Every land has its own culture.
example.traditional: 每個國家都有自己嘅文化。
example.jyutping: mui5 go3 gwok3 gaa1 dou1 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 man4 faa3

rows.note: Use this for the regional or general-place slice of “land,” rather than a sovereign country.

example.english: This land has developed quickly in recent years.
example.traditional: 呢個地方近年發展得好快。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 gan6 nin4 faat3 zin2 dak1 hou2 faai3

rows.note: Use this when a punch, blow, or other attack hits its intended target.

example.english: That punch did land on my stomach.
example.jyutping: go2 kyun4 daa2 zung3 ngo5 go3 tou5

rows.note: Use this when a person or vessel arrives on land from the water.

example.english: The boat will land before dawn.
example.jyutping: zek3 syun4 tin1 gwong1 cin4 soeng5 ngon6
